svg.aria-label: Four ranged and area abilities side by side, each with four numbered steps coloured by the machine that runs them. Shoot: hold aim activates without paying, RT makes the server spawn a projectile carrying the hit spec, every machine moves it and the server applies the spec on overlap, and the third shot pays mana and starts the cooldown. Thrust: commit and wait for the start event, a speed effect from the server plus forward input on the attacker's PC, a detection sphere on a socket, and the server launches, damages and burns each enemy. Smash and stun: a radius effect at the ability level sets the radius attribute, the hit notify sweeps with it, the impact slows the caster and starts the VFX effect, and the server skips airborne targets before pushing and applying the effect. Nightflare: using the item activates the granted ability, which overlaps a 240 radius sphere, filters targets and applies the blind effect. Below, an in-match upgrade raises the ability level, which every spec reads for radius, damage, stun length, VFX length, thrust speed and shoot cooldown. Links: the shop, levelling and melee feed in; the AI, the damage pipeline and knockback read from it.
svg.text: Tick moves it on every machine;
server applies the spec on overlap
Finds targets with a sphere on you
Finds targets with a bigger sweep
skip anyone in the air → push
each spec reads the next row of its curve table
Shop: the Nightflare item, Scorched and Deadeye premium upgrades
Levelling: upgrade points raise levels · Melee: the same sweep
AI: skeletons read the smash / stun radius to dodge out of it
Damage pipeline: every hit effect · Knockback: PushTarget
